report_draft_physics_sensor_review_20260.scope: Independent read-only review of current root Markdown draft; final selected-v1 tables were knowingly still pending. No root report/model modifications or new native runs.
checked_equations: A/B/S translational balances and both-rigid Rz = Fa + (mB+mS)*(g_axis+aS) are consistent when Fa is net of actual guide friction.
Reaction vector R=N*n-mu*N*t, N=(Rz-s*Rx)/sqrt(1+s*s), and measured friction ratio signs are consistent for positive scanning.
Raw reaction reconstruction R=Lraw+mS*(aS-g_vec), or consistently tared R=Ltared+mS*aS, remains correct with the compliant upstream series link.
Matched force/acceleration transfer equation Rhat=HL*R+mS*(Ha-HL)*f is correct; a synchronized ADC alone does not equalize complete transfer.
Selected inverse needs positive mB/Kf*s*s/(k+c*s) applied to requested axial-load deviation minus identified S inertia, with proper rolloff.

required_draft_updates.change: Label the 1.64 kHz mode as the rigid-lower finite-cell comparison. State selected lower pair open mode 28.8725 Hz; ideal massless series cell stiffness correction 0.03084%; real proximal fixture modes remain unqualified.
Add +lower_inverse_current to the final selected-v1 current equation, and give its identified-parameter load-inverse formula separately.
Show B -> parallel opposed spring pair/damper -> joining frame -> multi-axis cell -> S. All distal support forces must pass the cell.
Describe six amplified/conditioned bridge channels, followed by ATI calibration matrix. TWE needs custom conditioning; the published 5.1 kHz analog response belongs to DAQ F/T.
Avoid unverified typ/max column attribution for the approximately 0.65 us conversion provision. Include ADC analog input-filter phase and total measured processing latency.
Keep the ideal quantum/noise calculation a starting budget; ADC analog/conversion/reference noise, drift, installed sensor phase and vibration are separate contributions.

With the compliant link, S-relative-A velocity differs from actual actuator B-relative-A velocity by qdot. Do not describe the existing guide estimate as an exact B velocity; a causal measured-load constitutive observer is available if native errors justify adding it.

selected_low_and_fixture_modes.meaning: Analytical assembly sensitivities for 64 MN/m cell and additional proximal mass; not identified modes or a completed native high-mode qualification.

primary_sensor_sources.checked: 25 ug/sqrt(Hz) typical ADXL1002, +/-50 g, 40 mV/g at 5 V, 4.7 kHz 5% band, 11 kHz response gain-rise definition, 21 kHz mechanical resonance; external band limiting and installed mounting are required.

Eight simultaneous channels, 0-5 V supported. Analog input filter 25 kHz with 6.8 us phase delay in low-bandwidth mode; 220 kHz/1.1 us general high-bandwidth, 150 kHz/1.5 us in 0-5 V. Oversampling adds conversion/filter latency. Table3 tCONV extracted values 0.5 and 0.65 us; typ/max column attribution not relied upon here.

DAQ six bridge outputs are amplified and conditioned, then matrix-converted after digitizing; DAQ anti-alias is two-pole 5.1 kHz. TWE supplies no built-in conditioning/AA and requires customer electronics. Tooling affects sensor mechanical response.

report_draft_physics_sensor_review_20260.report_ready_mechanical_sentence: The selected opposed spring pair and parallel damper form a compliant link above the B-S cell. This gives a modeled holder mode near 29 Hz. The much stiffer cell changes that low-frequency stiffness by only about 0.03%, but the real joining frame, cell and mounts can add higher modes that must be identified on the loaded assembly.
report_draft_physics_sensor_review_20260.report_ready_sensor_sentence: Use synchronized conditioned force and tool-acceleration channels, a common coordinate frame, calibrated downstream mass, and an identified common amplitude/phase response. The ADC conversion time and ideal bit quantum do not by themselves specify the full acquisition latency, noise or force accuracy.
